method.emulation: Chrome headless, 393x851 CSS px, DPR 2, touch viewport, CPU throttling x4
method.scope: local production build; temporary CSS overrides only; no product source mutation
method.limitation: This is a controlled renderer signal, not a physical-device profile. No GPU raster or input-latency conclusion should be drawn from it alone.

interpretation: No controlled scenario crossed 25 ms in the synthetic run. The result de-prioritizes the closed header as a root cause, but cannot exclude device-specific compositor/raster pressure from SVG masks, blur, backdrop-filter, video decode, or simultaneous scroll/input work.
